categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: Represents items resolved via 3-way matching where the goods receipt precedes the invoice receipt. This alternative makes a strong positive contribution to preserving value-matching control integrity and is judged against the Time to clearance, 3-way after GR (days) indicator.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to the declared OR alternative 5 in the goal model. Supported by frequent variants like V0001 and V0002 where Record Goods Receipt precedes Vendor creates invoice and Record Invoice Receipt.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: Represents items resolved via 3-way matching where the invoice is recorded before the goods receipt occurs. This alternative helps maximize working-capital efficiency and preserve control integrity, and is judged against the Time to clearance, 3-way before GR (days) indicator.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to declared OR alternative 6 in the goal model, where the invoice arrives before the goods receipt (e.g., variant V0007).

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: Represents items resolved through a 2-way match where no goods receipt is required. This helps minimize procurement and matching overhead, and is judged against the Time to clearance, 2-way match (days) indicator.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to declared OR alternative 7 in the goal model for cases skipping goods receipt requirements.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
categories.description: Represents items resolved via consignment stock consumption. This helps minimize procurement and matching overhead, and is judged against exception/rework rates and clearance indicators.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to declared OR alternative task 13 in the goal model.
